title: Delp 2001: pcsa of quadratus lumborum at whole (mixed, cadaver)
muscle_as_reported: QL proximal, QL distal, QL total

quantity.name: pcsa
quantity.definition: physiological CSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / fibre length (x cos pennation if stated)

source.authors: Delp SL, Suryanarayanan S, Murray WM, Uhlir J, Triolo RJ
source.sample: 5 cadavers (3 F, 2 M; 4 unembalmed, 1 embalmed); cadaveric specimens, mean age 67 (9.1) y (2 unknown), height 170.6 (4.2) cm, mass 76.2 (13.3) kg

how_to_simulate: Sum the PCSA (or F_max / specific tension) of all model elements of quadratus lumborum, one side (or the named fascicle).
Compare with the cadaveric mean +/- SD; note specific tension and fibre-length normalisation used by the source.
protocol.notes: PCSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / optimal fascicle length. Table 3 compares with other studies' anatomical CSA (other authors; not stored).

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 rows single-line in text; re-read; abstract totals checked.
